ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this“Agreement"), is made as of June 30, 2022 by and between Steven Spektor ("Owner"), an individual having an address at 576 Sackett Street, Brooklyn, New York 11217 and Gowanus Union Street LLC ("Developer"), a Delaware limited liability company, having an address at c/o Tavros Holdings LLC, 19 West 24th Street,12th Floor,NewYork,NewYork10010. RECITALS: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner of certain land, with the building and improvements thereon (said building and improvements, the “Owner Building") in the City of New York, Borough of Brooklyn, known and numbered as 576 Sackett Street, Brooklyn, New York 11217, and currently designated as Tax Lot 23 in Block 433 on the Tax Map of the City of hereto (said land being herein called the “Owner Land,”" the Owner Land and the Owner Building collectively the "OwnerPremises"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon (said building and improvements, together with any replacements thereof, the “Developer Building") in the City of New York, Borough of Brooklyn, known and numbered as 585 Union Street, Brooklyn,New York 11215, and currently designated as Tax Lot 28 in Block 433 on the Tax Map as more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto (said land being herein called the “Developer Land,” the Developer Land and Developer Building collectively the "Developer Premises"); WHEREAS, the Owner Building contains less Floor Area (as hereinafter defined) than is available on the Owner Land pursuant to the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (the “Zoning Resolution"), such that Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) are available for transfer and utilization; WHEREAS,Owner wishestoretaincertainOwnerDevelopment Rights(as hereinafter defined) and transfer the Excess Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) to Developer; WHEREAS, Developer wishes to utilize the Excess Development Rights in improvements on the Developer Premises, which improvements may contain more Floor Area than would be permitted on the Developer Premises if such premises were treated as a separate zoning lot; WHEREAS, by execution and recording of a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions dated as of the date hereof and intended tobe recorded contemporaneously herewith (the “Declaration"), a copy of which is set forth in Exhibit C, Owner and Developer have utilized the procedure available under Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution to combine the Owner Land and the Developer Land as to create a new merged zoning lot, (as such merged zoning lot may be 1
